jobs.occupation: Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343
jobs.description: 1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV. * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures. * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components. * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools. * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures. * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration. * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines. * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware. * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues. * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders. * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. *  Experience in power electronic systems * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies. * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management. * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred) * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems. * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have. What to expect: * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities. * Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.Link: https://jobs.ait.ac.at/Job/268343 Das Mindestentgelt für die Stelle als Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion System...

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Head of Partnerships (m/f/d) The role

Partnerships is a major growth channel for fonio as we expand into new markets. As Head of Partnerships, you'll own the strategy and the results across two tracks:

 * Channel partners: resellers, referral partners, small agencies and IT shops. They activate fast, come in high volume and scale well.

 * Strategic partners: larger platforms, telcos and ecosystems. Cycles are longer and the prize is bigger.

You'll set the direction for both and decide where we place our bets. You'll also lead the team that delivers it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the room with partners, running calls and closing deals alongside your team. For us, partner activation is a sales motion. Success means partners who bring in revenue.

 * Design and scale the partner program: partner types, incentives, onboarding and enablement.

 * Lead and grow the partnerships team. Set clear priorities, coach, and hire as the channel scales.

 * Own the numbers: partner-sourced revenue, partners activated, time to first deal, and repeat activation.

 * Work with Sales, Marketing and Product on co-selling, co-marketing and integrations.

What you bring

 * You've led a partnerships or channel team at a SaaS company. AI is a bonus.

 * You come from a sales background and have carried a number. You treat partner activation as selling.

 * You've worked with partners in more than one market, ideally including the US and a European region.

 * You've built or scaled a partner program and know how to adapt it to different types of partner.

 * You have a track record of growing quickly into bigger scope and bigger teams.

 * You're fluent in English. German or Spanish is a plus.

 * You're comfortable travelling regularly to Vienna and to partner events.

What you get

 * Real ownership of a function that sits at the centre of our international growth.

 * A direct line to the CCO.

 * A team of ambitious people, many of them former founders.

 * Salary: €120000 - €160000 OTE, plus significant equity.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.
